name: The Westin Salgados Beach Resort , Algarve
insider_take: Perched on one of Algarve's most pristine stretches of coastline, this resort offers direct access to the protected Salgados Lagoon Nature Reserve – a rare blend of luxury beachfront living with untouched natural beauty.
whats_special: The resort sits uniquely between the Atlantic Ocean and the Salgados Lagoon, a protected wetland that's home to over 100 bird species including flamingos and purple herons. The property features Portugal's only Westin spa with indigenous salt treatments sourcing minerals from the nearby Ria Formosa lagoons.
pro_tip: Book a lagoon-view room during spring migration season (March-May) for spectacular flamingo watching right from your balcony, and request early morning bird-watching tours with the hotel's resident naturalist.
dont_miss: The 18-hole Salgados Golf Course designed by Donald Steel, carved through protected dunes and lagoon landscapes. Also experience the resort's signature "Salt Ritual" spa treatment using mineral-rich salts harvested from the adjacent nature reserve.
pros: Direct beachfront location on pristine Algarve coastline
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds and wellness amenities
Championship golf course access and premium facilities
Multiple dining options with local Portuguese cuisine
cons: Resort location requires transportation for local town exploration
